text:
amanda_support: Hey team — customer reported rerank results that look shifted across queries. They called the endpoint with a batched payload and got 200 + scores, but assignments don't line up with inputs.

 tim_eng: Can you paste their request (sanitized)?

 amanda_support: pasted below (removed PII):

 ```json
 {
   "queries": ["q1","q2","q3"],
   "candidates": [
     ["c1","c2"],
     [],
     ["c7"]
   ],
   "top_k": 3
 }
 ```

 amanda_support: They say the second query had zero candidates but our API returned scores for 3 results (looks like it borrowed from q1). Error-free 200 response, but obviously misaligned.

 diego_ml: This is likely the client/serializer flattening empty arrays when using CSV or streaming writer. If you send an empty array for one query sometimes the encoder omits it and the server consumes next candidates. Also seen when newline-delimited JSON lines were trimmed. Two quick repros: (1) missing-empty-array -> shift, (2) trailing comma in JSON -> parser recovers weirdly.

 tim_eng: Can you repro locally? If so please include curl we can run in CI.

 amanda_support: Repro cURL (works against staging):

 ```bash
 curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/rerank/batch \
   -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -d '{"queries":["q1","q2"],"candidates":[["a"],[]],"top_k":1}'
 ```

 amanda_support: On staging this returns scores for two items (server returned scores length 2 for q1 and q2) but the empty candidate for q2 produced a non-empty scoring array.

 diego_ml: Could be two issues: encoder stripping empty arrays or server-side concating candidate groups when any candidate list empty. I'll add a quick unit test to verify array lengths preserved. For immediate mitigation, ask customers to include explicit null placeholder: e.g. use `[[]]` or include a sentinel candidate with id "__EMPTY__" and filter after.

 tim_eng: Also capture the request bytes in logs — @sre-bot can you check ingress logs for thread 1938331123? Need to see the raw body as received.

 sre-bot: Ingress logs for 1938331123: raw_body_size=342 bytes; content (first 200 bytes): `{"queries":["q1","q2"],"candidates":[["a"],[]],"top_k":1}`

 amanda_support: Ok logs show body intact, so client didn't strip. That points to server-side compacting. Escalating to eng-runtime.

 diego_ml: I'll open a tracking PR to add defensive check: verify sum(len(c) for c in candidates) vs returned_scores_count and raise 400 if mismatch. Also add test for empty sublists.

 amanda_support: Ticket created: INF-4721. Notifying customer and offering workaround (send explicit placeholder). Will update once eng-runtime has patch. :eyes: 

 eli_se: Thanks, looping in account team for refund consideration if customer hit high error rate.

 amanda_support: marking for follow-up tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
